# Projection goldens (M1.7, ADR 0013)

`site/` is the exact served tree that `projectSite` builds for one synthetic site, relative to
the prefix: `changes.json` per run, stream files, PR pointers, the API index, `site.json` and
`llms.txt`. The served JSON Schemas are left out; a test compares them with `schemaFor`.

Everything here is generated by `tools/projection-goldens/generate.ts` from the recorded
comparator outputs in `../comparator/`. Never edit these files by hand.

| Run | Built from |
|---|---|
| `11-a1` (PR 7) | the tiny cases with a baseline (`../comparator/tiny/`) |
| `10-a1` (push) | the tiny cases with no baseline |
| `36405830015-a1` (PR 123) | PropertyScope PR #123's recorded pixel hashes and comparisons |
| `36287837535-a1` (push) | TracePilot run 36287837535's recorded pixel hashes and comparisons |

The real runs keep their recorded run IDs, attempts, events, commits and artifact IDs. Repository
and workflow IDs, created times, workflow/config/release SHAs and the tiny run's PR number are
synthetic. The four runs share one store and site at `https://owner.github.io/repo/pixelwatch/`.

`packages/core/test/changes-projection.test.ts` rebuilds the tree and compares bytes. A run's
`changes.json` must never change under its URL, so a byte change there needs an ADR (and, for
served runs, a new API version). Regenerate only when the recordings change or an ADR changes the
projection:

```sh
node tools/projection-goldens/generate.ts
```
